$comment: Discovered content is preferred over what is listed here: the API suite reads /v1/content, /v1/types and the menus to build its request mix at setup time. Everything in this file is a fallback or an addition. Frontend entries override FRONTEND_URLS paths per site; a frontend named in FRONTEND_URLS but not here gets defaultFrontendPaths.

graphql.listFields: id title slug permalink locale updatedAt
graphql.pageFields: id title slug permalink locale publishedAt updatedAt

$controls: With CONTROLS=on, controls.settings (a control API settings body) replaces the built-in set in scripts/lib/controls.js, e.g. { "settings": { "rateLimits": { "delivery.space": { "max": 100000, "windowSeconds": 60 } } } }.
$paths: Any path may carry a {permalink} placeholder, which is replaced with a permalink discovered from the public API, e.g. "/blog/{permalink}".
$host: An entry may set "host" to send that Host header instead of the URL's: a Vite or Nuxt dev server answers 403 to any name but its own, so an entry pointing at one needs host: localhost:<port>. See $frontendsExample for the shape of an entry.
